pr_title: Fix native library loading zstd with jna
pr_body:
Recent refactoring of native library paths broke jna loading zstd. This commit fixes jna to set the jna.library.path during init so that jna calls to load libraries still work.

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/112182

review_comments: Will `toString` return a path with the right separators to be parsed properly on all platforms?

Yes. The javadoc for `Path.toString()` mentions the following:

> The returned path string uses the default name separator to separate names in the path.
Sounds good. I wasn't totally certain the "default name separator" was one that worked on all platforms.
Would it be better to do this in `SystemJvmOptions` rather than in a static initializer?

No, that was the problem we had before, it made NativeAccess unusable in the CLI. I moved it into here so that this can work even when we haven't gone through SystemJvmOptions (which is only for the main ES process).
